basic_info.description: Perched on the scenic hills of Merced Heights, this renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bath home boasts designer finishes & breathtaking Northwestern ocean & neighborhood views. Featuring a bonus family room and a beautifully terraced rear yard, this home is filled with quality details, including in-floor radiant heating and a 2024 roof. The stylish kitchen is equipped w/a four-burner gas range, custom wood cabinetry, a tile backsplash, & high-end stainless-steel appliances. A bar counter offers a casual dining space, while the adjacent living room features a cozy electric corner gas fireplace and access to dining area. This level also includes 2 spacious rear-facing bedrooms w/large closets & sliding glass doors out to a deck overlooking the garden. The luxurious tiled bathroom features a spa-like sunken jetted tub, a walk-in glass shower, and a spacious vanity. The lower level, accessible via an interior staircase, offers a generous entertainment room w/wetbar & direct access to the rear patio. A private third bedroom suite on this level includes its own  bathroom w/shower. Conveniently located near Ocean Avenue's Whole Foods, Brooks Park, CCSF, and SFSU, this home offers easy access to city conveniences. Nearby MUNI bus lines and close proximity to 280 and 101 freeways and Balboa Bart.
